#!/bin/sh
# Stands in for a libtest binary: `--list --format terse`, and
# `--exact <name>`, which spawns the tool the test of that name reaches.
if [ "$1" = "--list" ]; then
    for t in reads_the_stubbed_tool reads_the_stubbed_tool_keyed reads_the_stubbed_tool_marked \
        reads_the_raw_tool reads_through_another_tool reads_nothing; do
        echo "tests::$t: test"
    done
    exit 0
fi
case "$2" in
    tests::reads_the_stubbed_tool*) faketool ;;
    # The spawn is made with no environment at all, the way `env_clear()` does it.
    tests::reads_the_raw_tool) env -i "$(command -v rawtool)" ;;
    tests::reads_through_another_tool) sh -c 'faketool; :' ;;
esac
exit 0
